note: Single source for facts that change often. Checks, the report format, and scripts/scan.py read values from here. Update this file first when refreshing the skill.

upload_requirements.summary: Uploads must be built with Xcode 26 or later and the iOS 26 SDK
Uploads must be built with Xcode 27 or later and the iOS 27 SDK (Apple announced April 2027 without a day)

scene_lifecycle.rule: Apps built on Xcode 27 images launch on iOS 27 only with the UIKit scene life cycle; SDK 57 needs the flag, older SDKs must use auto or their sdk alias

deadlines.item: Declare Shared Location and Dating and Relationships in the age rating questionnaire when submitting an update or editing the age rating
Every app must have the Shared Location and Dating and Relationships declarations
Existing Health and Fitness or Medical apps in the EU/EEA, UK, or US must declare regulated medical device status (Apple: "early 2027") or lose the ability to submit updates
Uploads require Xcode 27 and the iOS 27 SDK
Submissions must include iPhone Duo screenshots
